What's your return and refund policy?
Return window: Statutory 14‑day withdrawal for EU/UK (return must be registered in this period, then handed to the carrier within another 14 days) plus a voluntary 30‑day return right for all customers from receipt of goods.
Conditions: Items must be unused, complete, and in original packaging for the voluntary 30‑day right. If used beyond normal inspection, we may deduct depreciation.
How to return: Please register your return via our Return Portal first. Afterwards you can:
Use our prepaid return label (a return fee may be deducted from your refund depending on country), or
Use a carrier of your choice at your own cost, or
Return for free in person at one of our Flagship Stores (for online orders).
Shipping cost refunds: If you return your entire order, we also refund the cost of the cheapest standard shipping. If you keep at least one item, original shipping costs are not refunded. For some countries (e.g. Switzerland), original shipping costs may be retained.
Refund timing: Once your return arrives and is inspected, we refund to your original payment method, usually within up to 8 business days; your bank may add a few days.
Return fees: If you use our label, a return fee according to our policy may be deducted from the refund; if you organise shipping yourself, no return fee is charged by us.
After 30 days: In some cases, if the item is completely unused and in original packaging, we may still find a solution individually.
Incomplete refunds: Common reasons are staged refunds for multi‑package returns, deducted return fees, retained original shipping for certain countries, or discount conditions no longer being met after a partial return.
